concept: SSM Automation runbooks + CloudWatch alarm actions: auto-remediation
tests: How to automate an operational response (service restart) via a runbook when a CloudWatch alarm fires.
expected: Systems Manager Automation runbooks (repeatable remediation steps) + CloudWatch alarm actions that invoke SSM Automation or Lambda. Triggers: "automate operational responses", "when alarm fires", "predefined runbooks", (Choose two).
why_not: Macie classifies sensitive data and Shield protects against DDoS; neither relates to remediation automation.
